name: Woodlands
summary: Northern gateway living — Causeway access to Johor, more space per dollar, and a different social curve than Holland V or East Coast.
body: Woodlands works when your geography is actually northern: Johor Bahru ties, Singapore American School / Woodlands corridor logistics, or a deliberate bet on space and rent versus central condos. Causeway Point covers daily retail; waterfront parks and town amenities are real — but Causeway congestion and long CBD days are the tax. Housing spans HDB, suburban condos, and some landed; verify HDB foreigner rental eligibility before shortlisting blocks. Expat social density is thinner than Holland Village or River Valley — you build community through school, sport, or JB weekends rather than lobby WhatsApp defaults. Weekend JB runs from here are logistically easier than from the East Coast, but Friday-evening and Sunday-night queues still erase the 'quick trip' fantasy. Shortlist only if work start times and school runs survive a bad Causeway morning; do not pick Woodlands for 'savings' alone if your office is in the CBD five days a week. Car ownership is not mandatory — model Grab + occasional Malaysia hire before a COE.
housingMix: Condos, HDB, landed — more space per dollar than central.
commuteNotes: North-South Line at Woodlands / Woodlands South; Thomson-East Coast Line connectivity improving the north — still plan expressway timing carefully. Causeway / Second Link choice depends on JB destination.
